approval_ref: The user requested continued development, testing and iteration; the second authorized Flash run isolated remaining citation-reference and percentage-shape failures.
notes: Keep real evidence and region IDs in local receipts, canonical citations and immutable results.
Expose only deterministic compact E1..En and V1..Vn references to the provider and resolve them by bounded input order.
Permit one PERCENT_OF item to express one cited base with one or more cited percentages; compile each percentage to a separate canonical calculation.
Do not add a retry, verifier model, semantic index or database migration.
Use synthetic offline tests only; a later full paid benchmark remains a separate operational decision.
title: Use compact QA evidence references
objective: Reduce remaining small-model citation and percentage-shape failures by replacing opaque provider-facing IDs with compact local aliases while preserving exact canonical provenance.
